; TYPED IN XAS 7.447 FOR THE FORMAT RESEAH
start   ORG   #6000
        ENT
        LD    HL,text
        LD    DE,#4000
loop    LD    A,(HL)
        OR    A
        RET   Z
        RST   16
        INC   HL
        JR    loop
        LD    (IX+5),A
        LD    A,(IY-1)
        OUT   (#fe),A
        PUSH  BC,DE,HL
        POP   HL,DE,BC
        EX    AF,AF'
        EX    (SP),HL
text    DB    "HELLO",13,0
        DW    start,loop+1
        DS    5,#ff
        DM    "ABC"
        BIT   7,(HL)
        IM    2
        JP    (HL)
        DJNZ  loop
        CP    "A"
        SUB   10;SUB
cnt     EQU   5
lab2    NOP;LABEL ONLY
